marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind west 20 knots backing to south 15 late Wednesday
morning. Periods of snow ending Wednesday morning with a risk of
freezing drizzle. Fog patches forming Wednesday morning. Visibility as low as 1
mile in snow and 1 mile or less in fog patches. Low tonight minus 2. High Wednesday plus 4. <br/>
